title: This was two nights ago..
content: So I went to the hotel in mall world last night and actually got to stay .. it was supposed to be a trip between me and one other person. And then they ended up being four of us. I don’t know who I was with, but the two others were a couple. And I did not like her. At some point, we got into a physical fight. This was all before check-in. So we check in and when we first open the door, there’s a woman who said that she’s made some popcorn for us. I don’t remember what else she said, and then she left. We walk further into the room which is a suite so we walk into one of the bedrooms, and there is a woman there sitting on the bed, which is unmade with the linens, sitting folded, and ready to put on. She basically tells us that this is her room and that we can have it till tomorrow morning. I said no, I’m gonna go back down to the desk and see if we can get our own room. And she said good luck the hotel is sold out. So we were like fine fuck it we’ll stay. I remember smoking. I was smoking cigarettes. And I also had a fat sack of weed. Cops come knocking at the door. I was really freaked out because I didn’t want them to take my bag of weed. They asked me to come out, which when I do, it looks like an embassy suites where all of the rooms are on the edges going around and then there’s a big atrium in the middle. And the cop asks me are you difficult? And I said sometimes. And then I woke up.
